主要内容: Medallion Financial Corp. issued a press release announcing its results for the quarter ended December 31, 2014 and the year ended December 31, 2014. The Compensation Committee of the board of directors approved fiscal year 2014 bonuses to key executives, including $500,000 to Alvin Murstein, $1,900,000 to Andrew Murstein, $135,000 to Larry Hall, $170,000 to Michael Kowalsky, and $300,000 to John Taggart. The Committee also approved salary increases for these executives, with Alvin Murstein’s base salary raised to $860,368, Andrew Murstein’s to $1,006,970, Larry Hall’s to $309,398, and John Taggart’s to $250,950. Michael Kowalsky’s base salary was increased to $329,663 effective July 1, 2015, as per his previously filed employment agreement dated August 3, 2006. The Committee granted 45,990 shares of restricted common stock to Michael Kowalsky as part of the compensation package. These actions reflect the Company’s overall performance in 2014 and its commitment to rewarding executive achievements and aligning compensation with company goals.
